raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With `--disaggregation-decode-retraction-backup cpu_tensor`, a retracted PD decode request copies its KV to CPU and frees its slots. On resume it gets new slots, and the backup is written into them.

Only the target KV pool is backed up. EAGLE/EAGLE3, multi-layer EAGLE, DFLASH and DSPARK drafts that do not share the target pool keep their own KV tensors, indexed by the same token slots. Once another request reuses the freed slots, the resumed request's draft reads that request's KV. Drafts then come from the wrong context, so the acceptance rate drops. Output stays correct, because the target verifies every draft token.

The `host_pool` backend already moves draft KV through its pool transfers. `cpu_tensor` does not.

## Modifications

- `BaseSpecWorker.retraction_draft_pools()` returns the draft KV pools that a target-slot backup can carry: MHA pools with tensors of their own, indexed by the target's token slots. It skips:
  - fused drafts and drafts that write into the target pool, since the target backup already holds their KV;
  - pools shared by several draft runners, which are backed up once;
  - MLA pools, whose `get_cpu_copy` maps token ids to this DCP rank's rows;
  - the page-major MHA layout, which has no CPU copy.
- `DFlashWorkerV2` returns no pools when it uses the compact draft cache. That cache has its own request->token table, so its rows are not the target's slots.
- `Scheduler.init_memory_pools` registers these pools on the target allocator when the backend resolves to `cpu_tensor`.
- `Req.offload_kv_cache` and `load_kv_cache` copy every registered pool with the target KV. The copies are stored in `RetractionBackup.draft_cpu_tensors`.

## Accuracy Tests

The model forward is unchanged. Without this PR, a resumed request's draft reads another request's KV; that only lowers acceptance, because the target verifies every token. The unit test checks the restored draft KV directly.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Retraction with `cpu_tensor` now also copies draft KV, roughly one extra copy per draft layer. Retraction is the slow path; other steps are unchanged.

## Tests

`test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_retraction_draft_kv_backup.py` (new, CPU, 5 cases):

- A request with two draft pools (multi-layer EAGLE) is backed up through `backup_kv_cache`. Its slots are overwritten, and it is restored on different slots. The target KV and both draft pools hold the request's original KV.
- Without registration, the draft pools still hold the overwritten values after restore.
- Pool selection keeps a separate MHA draft pool once, and skips the target pool, fused drafts, page-major pools and MLA pools.
- DFLASH with the compact draft cache registers nothing; without the compact cache it registers its draft pool.

On `main`, 4 of the 5 cases fail. With this PR all 5 pass.

The fake allocator in `test_retraction_mamba_backup.py` gains a `retraction_draft_pools = ()` attribute.

`test_retraction_draft_kv_backup.py`, `test_retraction_mamba_backup.py`, `test_decode_retraction_backup.py` and `test/registered/unit/speculative/` on one GPU: 33 passed.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).

nodes.body:
`retraction_draft_pools` skips MLA, page major and DFlash compact pools, so those drafts still resume on another request's KV silently. Should a draft pool that does not qualify refuse `cpu_tensor` at startup or abort at retraction via `backup_saved=False`?

`host_pool` has no draft handling either. Unsupported with a separate draft pool, or the same gap?

Correction to my second question: `host_pool` already carries draft KV. `UnifiedRadixCache.backup_kv_cache` adds a DRAFT pool transfer (`test_restores_target_and_draft_kv`), and #47124 refuses packed draft pools for the page envelope receive at startup. Only `cpu_tensor` needed this fix.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.
Two things might need a follow-up or be included in this PR.

Can we include MLA pools here? An MLA target never resolves to `host_pool`, so DSV3/R1 + NextN always ends up on `cpu_tensor` and still resumes on another request's draft KV after this PR. The DCP mapping is identity when `dcp_size == 1` and matches what the target copy does otherwise, so it should just work.

```suggestion
            if (
                not runner.runner_ids.is_fused_draft
                and pool is not target_pool
                and pool not in pools
                and isinstance(pool, (MHATokenToKVPool, MLATokenToKVPool))
                and not isinstance(pool, PageMajorMHATokenToKVPool)
```

+"""PD CPU retraction must carry draft KV that lives outside the target pool."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import Req, ReqKvInfo
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.allocator import TokenToKVPoolAllocator
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.common import backup_kv_cache, restore_kv_cache
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool import (
+    MHATokenToKVPool,
+    MLATokenToKVPool,
+    PageMajorMHATokenToKVPool,
+)
+from sglang.srt.speculative.base_spec_worker import BaseSpecWorker
+from sglang.srt.speculative.dflash_worker_v2 import DFlashWorkerV2
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+SIZE = 64
+
+
+def _mha_pool(layers, base, cls=MHATokenToKVPool):
+    pool = object.__new__(cls)
+    pool.use_hnd = False
+    pool.layer_num = layers
+    pool.cpu_offloading_chunk_size = 5
+    pool.k_buffer = [
+        (torch.arange(SIZE, dtype=torch.float32) + base + 100 * layer).view(SIZE, 1, 1)
+        for layer in range(layers)
+    ]
+    pool.v_buffer = [buf + 50 for buf in pool.k_buffer]
+    return pool
+
+
+def _buffers(pool):
+    return (*pool.k_buffer, *pool.v_buffer)
+
+
+def _runner(pool, fused=False):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        token_to_kv_pool=pool, runner_ids=SimpleNamespace(is_fused_draft=fused)
+    )
+
+
+def _spec_worker(target_pool, draft_runners, cls=BaseSpecWorker):
+    worker = object.__new__(cls)
+    worker._target_worker = SimpleNamespace(
+        model_runner=SimpleNamespace(token_to_kv_pool=target_pool)
+    )
+    worker._draft_model_runners = lambda: tuple(draft_runners)
+    return worker
+
+
+def _retract_and_resume(register):
+    """Back up a request, let another request overwrite its slots, restore it
+    on relocated slots, and return (target, drafts, expected, new slots)."""
+    target = _mha_pool(2, base=1000)
+    # Multi-layer EAGLE: one pool per draft step.
+    drafts = [_mha_pool(1, base=3000), _mha_pool(1, base=5000)]
+    allocator = TokenToKVPoolAllocator(
+        SIZE, torch.float32, "cpu", target, need_sort=False
+    )
+    if register:
+        allocator.register_retraction_draft_pools(tuple(drafts))
+
+    req = object.__new__(Req)
+    req.kv = ReqKvInfo(req_pool_idx=0)
+    req.origin_input_ids = [1] * 9
+    req.output_ids = [2] * 4
+    old = torch.cat((torch.arange(4, 10), torch.arange(30, 36)))
+    req_pool = SimpleNamespace(
+        req_to_token=old.unsqueeze(0).clone(), holds_state_slots=False
+    )
+    expected = {
+        "target": [buf[old].clone() for buf in _buffers(target)],
+        "draft": [buf[old].clone() for pool in drafts for buf in _buffers(pool)],
+    }
+
+    assert backup_kv_cache(req, None, req_pool, allocator, "cpu_tensor")
+    for pool in (target, *drafts):
+        for buf in _buffers(pool):
+            buf.fill_(-1)
+    new = old + 12
+    req_pool.req_to_token = new.unsqueeze(0)
+    restore_kv_cache(req, None, req_pool, allocator, "cpu_tensor")
+    assert req.kv.retraction_backup is None
+    return target, drafts, expected, new
+
+
+def test_round_trip_restores_every_draft_pool_on_relocated_slots():
+    """Reused slots must not leak into a resumed request's draft KV."""
+    target, drafts, expected, new = _retract_and_resume(register=True)
+    for got, want in zip((buf[new] for buf in _buffers(target)), expected["target"]):
+        torch.testing.assert_close(got, want)
+    got = [buf[new] for pool in drafts for buf in _buffers(pool)]
+    for g, want in zip(got, expected["draft"]):
+        torch.testing.assert_close(g, want)
+
+
+def test_unregistered_draft_pool_resumes_on_another_requests_kv():
+    """Without registration only the target KV comes back."""
+    _, drafts, _, new = _retract_and_resume(register=False)
+    assert all((buf[new] == -1).all() for pool in drafts for buf in _buffers(pool))
+
+
+def test_only_full_slot_mha_draft_pools_are_backed_up():
+    target = _mha_pool(1, base=0)
+    full = _mha_pool(1, base=10)
+    page_major = _mha_pool(1, base=20, cls=PageMajorMHATokenToKVPool)
+    mla = object.__new__(MLATokenToKVPool)
+    fused = _mha_pool(1, base=30)
+    worker = _spec_worker(
+        target,
+        [
+            _runner(full),
+            _runner(full),  # a shared pool is backed up once
+            _runner(target),  # a draft writing into the target pool
+            _runner(fused, fused=True),
+            _runner(page_major),
+            _runner(mla),
+        ],
+    )
+    assert worker.retraction_draft_pools() == (full,)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("compact", [False, True])
+def test_dflash_compact_draft_cache_keeps_its_own_rows(compact):
+    target = _mha_pool(1, base=0)
+    draft = _mha_pool(1, base=10)
+    worker = _spec_worker(target, [_runner(draft)], cls=DFlashWorkerV2)
+    worker.use_compact_draft_cache = compact
+    assert worker.retraction_draft_pools() == (() if compact else (draft,))

issue_comments.body:
`retraction_draft_pools` skips MLA, page major and DFlash compact pools, so those drafts still resume on another request's KV silently. Should a draft pool that does not qualify refuse `cpu_tensor` at startup or abort at retraction via `backup_saved=False`?

`host_pool` has no draft handling either. Unsupported with a separate draft pool, or the same gap?

Correction to my second question: `host_pool` already carries draft KV. `UnifiedRadixCache.backup_kv_cache` adds a DRAFT pool transfer (`test_restores_target_and_draft_kv`), and #47124 refuses packed draft pools for the page envelope receive at startup. Only `cpu_tensor` needed this fix.
